title: A finite type algebra of relative dimension n is quasi-finite over a polynomial algebra in n variables after inverting one element
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a finite type ring map whose relative dimension at a prime equals n becomes quasi-finite over a polynomial algebra in n variables after inverting one element (statement lines 31386-31394). The proof works in the fibre, where the relative dimension becomes the dimension of a finite type algebra over a field, applies Noether normalisation there, lifts the resulting polynomial subalgebra to the source, and spreads the resulting quasi-finiteness out using openness of that condition (proof lines 31396-31425). Doing the normalisation in the fibre rather than over the base is the step that makes the construction possible. H2.
